chapters.reason: The paper investigates the functional role of individual layers, demonstrating that different layers are activated during prompt processing versus response generation, which aligns with micro-level functional differentiation.
The study identifies that specific layers (often intermediate) are selectively activated to perform reasoning tasks, supporting the concept of specialized computational sub-circuits.
The paper explores how skipping layers (voids) affects reasoning performance on benchmarks like MMLU and GPQA, linking layer usage to reasoning capability.
